name: Nankana Sahib
summary: Birthplace of Guru Nanak Dev Ji in 1469. Gurdwara Janam Asthan stands on the site.

name: Sultanpur Lodhi
summary: Where Guru Nanak Dev Ji worked as a storekeeper and, around 1499, had his experience in the Bein river.

name: Eminabad
summary: Home of Bhai Lalo. Guru Nanak Dev Ji witnessed Babur's attack on the town and described it in the Babarvani hymns.

name: Kartarpur
today: Punjab, Pakistan, close to the border
summary: The town Guru Nanak Dev Ji founded on the Ravi, where he lived his final years and died in 1539.

name: Khadur Sahib
summary: Home of Bhai Lehna, who became Guru Angad Dev Ji and led the Sikhs from here from 1539 to 1552.

name: Goindwal Sahib
summary: On the Beas river. The centre of the Sikh community under Guru Amar Das Ji.

name: Amritsar
summary: Founded by Guru Ram Das Ji. Guru Arjan Dev Ji installed the Adi Granth at Harmandir Sahib here in 1604.

name: Lahore
summary: Provincial capital under the Mughals. Guru Arjan Dev Ji was martyred here in 1606.

name: Kiratpur Sahib
summary: In the Shivalik foothills. Guru Hargobind Sahib Ji spent his later years here.

name: Anandpur Sahib
summary: Where Guru Gobind Singh Ji founded the Khalsa on Vaisakhi in 1699.
